messages:
Maria (Marketing): Draft ready for review — blog + benchmark callouts + webinar CTA. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/drafts/rl-inference-launch-v1
Alex (Product): On it. Can we call out latency and $/1k tokens in the benchmarks section? Product PM asked.
Jamie (Design): Need final hero image by EOD if we want the 4/5 publish. Can we use the rack photo or prefer custom render?
Maria (Marketing): Prefer render to match brand. @Jamie can you mock a 16:9 hero with redwood color palette? small copy overlay: 'Predictable inference, lower cost'
Sam (Legal): Quick legal check — please remove the phrase 'industry-leading' unless you have substantiation. Also, any customer quotes need written permission.
Maria (Marketing): Copy updated — replaced 'industry-leading' with 'high-performance' and flagged the customer quote as 'pending release approval'.
Olivia (Growth): Inbound routing: we'll pipe signups to HubSpot list 'launch-webinar-2026' and tag with utm_campaign=rl_launch_v1. @Alex can you confirm the demo slot field name? Need form mapping.
Alex (Product): Form field will be `demo_date_preference`. HubSpot property is `hs_demo_date_pref`. Mapping snippet: `demo_date_preference -> hs_demo_date_pref`
Maria (Marketing): Thanks. Also planning a follow-up nurture: 3 emails over 2 weeks, first is webinar invite. @PublishBot can you block 4/12 webinar slot in calendar?
PublishBot: Booked tentative webinar 2026-04-12 11:00 PT. Invite sent to speakers. Change requests go to #marketing.
Sam (Legal): Legal ok on copy changes; please attach the customer permission when you get it. :thumbsup:
Jamie (Design): Uploading hero draft now https://files.redwood.com/hero-renders/rl-hero-01.png
Maria (Marketing): Final ask — can someone approve publish window? I'd like 4/5 9:00 PT publish. @Olivia @Alex
Olivia (Growth): 9:00 PT is good for APAC lead capture. :white_check_mark:
Alex (Product): Works for product. Approved.
Maria (Marketing): Great — I'll queue with the ops checklist and notify sales ops to expect inbound. Thanks team :rocket:
